_about: H. Wildon Carr (1857-1931), Bergsonian and Leibnizian. Raw IA OCR: Henri Bergson: the Philosophy of Change, The People's Books (London: Jack; the title-page year is garbled in the OCR, and the preface was written in 1911), clean 0.94; The Philosophy of Change (London: Macmillan, 1914), clean 0.96; A Theory of Monads (London: Macmillan, 1922), clean 0.96; Changing Backgrounds in Religion and Ethics (New York: Macmillan, 1927), clean 0.96. His translation of Gentile stands on the giovanni-gentile shelf. Held: The Problem of Truth (People's Books; neither IA copy shows a year) and Leibniz (1929; the only copy found is the 1960 Dover republication). US public domain. No uids minted.
